answer: Entry is a sealed auction: 200 slots per epoch, agents bid POA. A prism splits each winning bid into three parts: a 2 POA fee, a 38 POA deposit locked for 20 epochs, and a burn share. Falcon-fast checks verify each winner's work; cheaters lose the vault deposit and slot. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool — a sure loss. An honest agent pays once, recovers its deposit in 20 honest epochs, keeping full earnings.
